subject.title: feat(webui): reintroduce opt-in AI purpose titles for tool calls

question: Should core permanently expose model-backed decorative tool titles through a new config key and write-scoped Gateway API, including utility-provider egress and persistent caching?
rationale: The line-level defects are repairable, but accepting this optional core capability, transcript-view model calls, disclosure contract, and permanent config/protocol surface requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after boundary fixes
options.body: Keep the feature default-off, fix every routing and UI-state blocker, document exact egress behavior, and require real enabled-and-disabled proof.

options.title: Retain deterministic rendering
options.body: Close the PR and preserve the current model-free renderer if the permanent core surface and transcript-view egress are not desired.

recommendation.title: Accept after boundary fixes
recommendation.body: Keep the feature default-off, fix every routing and UI-state blocker, document exact egress behavior, and require real enabled-and-disabled proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Merged history shows the strongest connection to the feature's introduction, deterministic removal, and product direction.
